page_title: PAR 0-0 NAP | Parma v Napoli 18/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+13' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+12' Philip Billing (Napoli) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Daniele Doveri blows his whistle for an infringement.
90+11' David Neres (Napoli) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The ball has crossed the sideline. Parma are taking a throw-in.
90+10' The Napoli players’ joy was short-lived as the original decision is reversed after a VAR review by referee Daniele Doveri. NO PENALTY!
90+7' The referee isn't 100% sure if it's a penalty to Napoli, he's going to review using VAR.
90+6' Mathias Lovik (Parma) trips an opposition player and Daniele Doveri signals a foul. Joy for one side, despair for the other as the referee gives a penalty to Napoli!
90+4' Pasquale Mazzocchi (Napoli) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
90+1' Referee halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Christian Chivu, then promptly shows him a RED CARD!
90+1' Antonio Conte is stunned as referee Daniele Doveri shows him a RED CARD.
90' There will be a minimum of 10 min. of added time.
89' Mathias Olivera (Napoli) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Parma.
89' Mathias Olivera (Napoli) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
86' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Pasquale Mazzocchi (Napoli) is coming onto the pitch as Leonardo Spinazzola cannot continue after picking up an injury.
86' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Ange-Yoan Bonny walks off the pitch to be replaced by Jacob Ondrejka (Parma).
85' Substitution. Mathias Lovik (Parma) in, Emanuele Valeri out.
85' Christian Chivu has decided to make a change. Milan Djuric (Parma) replaces Mateo Pellegrino.
82' Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) commits a foul and Daniele Doveri immediately signals a free kick.
80' Antonio Conte prepares a substitution. Romelu Lukaku is replaced by Giovanni Simeone (Napoli).
80' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Cyril Ngonge (Napoli) will replace Matteo Politano.
79' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) sends the ball into the penalty area from a throw-in as if it's a corner kick.
78' Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) sends in a lofted cross from a long-range free kick, but it goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Napoli.
77' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Philip Billing (Napoli) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Parma have been awarded a free kick.
76' Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross. The ball goes out of play and Parma will have a goal kick.
76' It will be a substitution. Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) is ready to enter the pitch as Hernani walks off.
76' The fouls committed statistics – 12:10.
73' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
71' Matteo Politano (Napoli) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
71' Scott McTominay (Napoli) takes the free kick from just outside the box and unleashes a fine shot to the roof of the net, but his effort is thwarted by Zion Suzuki who parries it onto the post.
70' Enrico Del Prato (Parma) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
70' A clumsy foul by Enrico Del Prato (Parma) and Daniele Doveri blows his whistle. Napoli have a free kick from a promising distance.
69' Antonio Conte decides to make a substitution. Giacomo Raspadori will be replaced by David Neres (Napoli).
69' Substitution. Philip Billing (Napoli) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Billy Gilmour walks off.
68' Napoli hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
65' Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) produces a killer pass onto Giacomo Raspadori, who loses the ball to one of the defenders.
65' Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Daniele Doveri blows his whistle for a foul.
63' Christian Chivu is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Giovanni Leoni (Parma) suffers an injury and Antoine Hainaut comes on.
61' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 6:7. 4:1 – this is the current number of shots on target.
60' Matteo Politano (Napoli) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
57' Matteo Politano (Napoli) shows off his amazing technique to get to the edge of the box by himself. He pulls the trigger but sends the ball onto the bar. Nice run, but unlucky finish!
57' Scott McTominay (Napoli) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
57' Half-chance! Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) plays a pass into the box, but Zion Suzuki reacts well to snuff out the attack.
55' Giovanni Leoni (Parma) is able to continue to play.
54' It doesn’t look good for Giovanni Leoni (Parma); looks like he’ll have to leave the pitch!
51' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) fails to deliver a decent cross from a long-range free kick. The opposition's defence intercepts the effort.
51' The players claim that Matteo Politano (Napoli) handled the ball and it seems they are right. There is a free kick near the sideline to Parma.
50' Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) is caught offside yet again.
49' Hernani (Parma) swings the ball into the box from the corner kick but it's a bit too strong and it goes out of play.
47' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Hernani (Parma), but one of the defenders gets it clear.

46' Simon Sohm (Parma) wastes an opportunity. He finds himself in acres of space and fires in a terrific shot from long range straight towards the top right corner, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one! Parma have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' Daniele Doveri has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
45' A neat pass is well received by Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball on goal. The goalkeeper makes a decent save to block his shot.
43' Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Daniele Doveri who sees an offensive foul.
43' An attempted cross from Matteo Politano (Napoli) is cleared.
41' Mandela Keita (Parma) changes the direction of the ball using his hand, but he is angry when the referee gives a foul against him.
41' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) has the ability to send the ball deep into the penalty area from throw-ins and it can lead to very promising situations for his team.
36' Having seen unsporting behavior, Daniele Doveri shows a yellow card to one of the players sitting on the bench. And Nahuel Estevez (Parma) is the recipient.
33' Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) is first to the lofted pass but plants a header miles over the bar from close in.
33' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) storms into the box to get on the end of a pass, but smashes his shot straight onto the right post. Unlucky!
32' Total attempts – 4:2. The current number of shots on goal is 3:1.
31' Hernani (Parma) fails to produce a decent cross from the corner kick. The ball goes well out of play.

30' Simon Sohm (Parma) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going into the roof of the net, but Alex Meret has other ideas and makes a brilliant save. The linesman points to the corner flag, Parma are going to take it.
30' Matteo Politano (Napoli) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
29' Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) brings an opponent down and Daniele Doveri interrupts the game.
26' A pass by Emanuele Valeri (Parma) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
23' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
22' Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.
20' Matteo Politano (Napoli) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
19' Amir Rrahmani (Napoli) sends a long ball in, but Zion Suzuki comfortably gathers the ball.

19' That didn't go as planned! Ange-Yoan Bonny (Parma) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the middle of the goal was too weak to get past Alex Meret, who easily kept it out.
17' 35:65 – the latest ball possession ratio.
17' Matteo Politano (Napoli) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away.
16' Antonio Conte appears to have said too much and referee Daniele Doveri comes over and theatrically shows him a yellow card.
14' Daniele Doveri interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Amir Rrahmani (Napoli).
11' Matteo Politano (Napoli) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the right side of the goal, but Zion Suzuki makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round!
10' Hernani (Parma) takes the free kick from the edge of the box but the defensive wall makes the block.
9' Billy Gilmour (Napoli) clearly handles the ball, but he is surprised when the referee blows his whistle. Parma win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
7' A pass from Ange-Yoan Bonny (Parma) is intercepted by Alex Meret and the move breaks down.
5' Matteo Politano (Napoli) fails to deliver a decent cross from the corner and the ball goes out of play.
4' Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball is out of play and Napoli manage to earn a corner.
4' A nice sequence of play ends with a shot by Ange-Yoan Bonny (Parma) from the edge of the box. The effort, however, is towards the middle of the goal where Alex Meret easily catches the ball.
3' Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while heading towards goal with the ball.
2' Great teamplay by Parma as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
1' The match has just started.
The players are on the pitch and Parma will have the kick-off.
Daniele Doveri will officiate today.
